program.name: Stride Builder
program.subject: Running prep
program.blurb: A longer stride: drills and an AMRAP one day, bounds and single-leg work the next.
program.about: For a longer, springier stride. One day is a drill circuit, then an AMRAP of fast feet, hops and lunges; the other is bounds and pogo hops in straight sets, then single-leg strength. They alternate. Abs finish every session. Level II brings harder variations and Level III adds reps.
